map.水光针配比计算 使用指南: Water-Light Mixing Ratio Calculator User Guide
map.水光针配比计算器，输入配方总量与各成分浓度配比求各成分体积，辅助水光注射配方调配: The water-light mixing ratio calculator takes the total formula volume and the concentration of each ingredient to return the per-ingredient volumes, helping prepare the injection formula.
map.折算配比 = 各成分配比 / 配比合计；体积 = 总量 × 折算配比；含量 =: Reduced ratio = each component ratio / ratio total; volume = total x reduced ratio; content = volume x reference concentration
map.配比合计偏离 100%（±0.5%）时按比例折算并提示。成分含量：玻尿酸 = 体: When the ratio total deviates from 100% (by more than +/-0.5%), scale by proportion and flag it. Ingredient content: hyaluronic acid = volume x input concentration (mg/ml); vitamin C, glutathione and other/PRP are converted at reference concentrations of 50 / 30 / 5 mg/ml. The tool outputs the converted ratio, volume and content of each ingredient plus the total, and shows the ratio structure as a bar chart, for composite injection (HA + VC + glutathione) formula accounting.
map.复配复核：多人治疗按总体积放大时保持比例一致。: Mixed-preparation check: when scaling up the total volume for multiple patients, keep the proportions consistent.
map.误差控制：提示四舍五入导致的累计偏差，建议先算总量再分配。: Error control: this flags accumulated deviation caused by rounding; compute the total first, then allocate.
map.教学演示：向新手解释「浓度×体积=有效量」的基本关系。: Teaching demo: explains the basic relation "concentration x volume = effective amount" for beginners.
